summary: "It's a Trap!" is a direct-to-video special of the animated series Family Guy that later served as the double-episode season finale of the show's ninth season. It is the final part of the series' Star Wars parody trilogy, following Laugh It Up, Fuzzball. The home video was released on December 21, 2010, and later aired on Fox in the United States on May 22, 2011.
one_line: A Family Guy direct-to-video special that became the ninth-season finale and closes the show's Star Wars parody trilogy.
